text:
lina: found a sticker on the whiteboard that says 'Semver: In Code We Trust' and now I have questions. :thinking_face:

harry: semver is quietly lobbying to be an official company religion. membership perks: perfect patch releases and fewer merge fights. :pray:

lint-bot: Warning: package.json uses non-canonical version string: "version": "v1". Recommended: follow semver (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). See docs: https://redwood.dev/release-guidelines :gear:

lina: the sticker also had a tiny meme: "semver walked into a bar, bartender asked for version, semver replied 'it's complicated'" :joy:

mike: meanwhile YAML over in the corner is sobbing because someone committed a comment with a tab, so the linter labeled it 'personal'.

sophia: compile-time meme for the day: "Type error: expected honesty but found semver 0xdeadbeef." :laughing:

harry: honest question poll: is semver a suggestion or a way of life? react with :thumbsup: for policy, :shrug: for suggestion, :pray: for cult.

lint-bot: Poll created: "Semver: Policy, Suggestion, or Cult?" Options: :thumbsup:, :shrug:, :pray:. Vote by reacting.

mike: voted :thumbsup: — policy. also pro-tip: don't name your prerelease tags 'hotfix' if you expect dignity.

sophia: posted an example of a mystical version string from yesterday's PR that caused confusion:
```
package.json:
  "version": "1.0.0-beta.0.0"
```

lina: that one looks like a semver incantation gone wrong. deploy-bot refused to tag it as a release and posted a tiny shaming GIF.

lint-bot: Deploy blocked: ambiguous prerelease field detected in version string. Suggest normalizing prerelease to a single dot-separated identifier.

harry: suggestion: add a CI check that auto-fixes common semver sins and comments with an explanatory meme so humans learn faster.

mike: also, small YAML fun fact: one stray trailing tab inside a block scalar can make your config behave like it has opinions. learned that the hard way.

sophia: tiny challenge: anyone who breaks semver gets assigned to write a 2-line compiler haiku in the team channel. I volunteer to judge.

lina: opening PR titled "ci: semver normalize + semver-lint + tiny memes". description: auto-fix common version formats and add clear error messages with helpful links. Sorry past humans.

lint-bot: @lina opened PR #701: "ci: semver normalize + semver-lint + tiny memes". CI checks queued. :thumbsup:

harry: voted :pray: in the poll because clearly I am susceptible to cult marketing. Closing with a friendly reminder: be kind to your linters, they only want consistency. :heart:
